evidence.detail: Launcher stores exactly one rs/gui/u in its JFrame field o and exposes it as the active Swing window through Launcher.i(); Client and UI/config subsystems reference that same frame.

The class directly extends JFrame and overrides setLocation/setBounds while adding monitor-aware clamping, maximize bounds, side-panel width changes and resize behavior; it owns no game rendering or protocol state.
The frame stores rs/gui/v and branches on KEEP_WINDOW_SIZE versus KEEP_GAME_SIZE when applying width changes, proving it is the launcher window geometry owner rather than a generic JFrame helper.

evidence.detail: The enum has exactly two values: KEEP_WINDOW_SIZE ('Keep window size') and KEEP_GAME_SIZE ('Keep game size').
LauncherWindowFrame stores this enum and branches on its two values while changing frame width/side-panel geometry.
The enum carries only its display String and exists solely as launcher-window resize behavior policy.
